metadata.title: OPC Bridge — Experimental OPC Initiatives Showcase
metadata.description: The official showcase platform for OPC experimental initiatives: AI decision intelligence, graph world models, space computing, and smart rail monitoring.

hero.subtitle: Four flagship projects spanning multi-source data fusion, graph world models, orbital space computing, and end-edge-cloud rail monitoring — from rail tracks to low Earth orbit, redefining decision intelligence and next-generation compute infrastructure.

projects.sectionSubtitle: Each project demonstrates a production-ready capability — from data fusion platforms to orbital compute networks — built to attract global investment.

contact.title: Let's Build the Future Together
contact.subtitle: We are seeking global investors and strategic partners to accelerate our experimental OPC initiatives. Reach out to discuss investment opportunities, pilots, and collaborations.

footer.tagline: The official showcase platform for OPC experimental initiatives.
